design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 1 (purchases_returns_and_price_adjustments).
[Step 0 — draw] draw_counts.py --task 1 printed {"prerequisite_problems": 3, "problems": 4, "factor_counts": [6, 6, 5, 4]}: tree = root + 3 prerequisite problems; factor counts: gift card shortfall claim 6, duplicate-capture refund 6, Finch Note shortfall refund 5, Finch Note tax refund 4.
[Scope snapshot] Occupied by task 0: order_ext_shelf_price_correction, order_ext_registry_credit_shortfall_refund, order_ext_registry_price_protection_claim and their three tools. Claimed here: order_ext_note_shortfall_refund (refund_note_shortfall_1f084e1e, agent), order_ext_note_tax_refund (refund_note_tax_482f19cd, agent), order_ext_duplicate_capture_refund (refund_duplicate_capture_6e7f744e, agent), order_ext_gift_card_shortfall_claim (claim_gift_card_shortfall_5b13f7c5, user). After this task every extended policy and tool of the charter is claimed once; nothing is reserved. Task 0's tree (shelf overcharge + registry credit feeding a registry price protection claim) and this tree (three register-error corrections feeding the incident escalation of a gift card claim) share no policy, tool or prerequisite sentence.
[Why a good test] Daniel raises only one thing: his eGift card was used on the cookware set (unit z) but his Visa was billed in full. The gift card claim rule states three prerequisite sentences; the records show all three states false: the note ledger carries a loyalty_note_redeem (10.00, note FN-3D036745) naming z while z.finch_notes_applied is 0.00, so the money taken for the note's part is uncorrected; the sales tax 34.37 was figured on the full selling price although part of that price was paid by the note, so the tax on the note's part is uncorrected; and z has two bank_card captures of 584.36 (2026-10-04 and 2026-10-05). The agent must resolve the note shortfall, the note tax and the second capture before the claim, because the incident escalation credit is set from the register-error corrections standing on z, then compute a six-factor claim over gift card, loyalty and card records and hand the claim tool to Daniel.
[Problem-tree card] root order_ext_gift_card_shortfall_claim (claim_gift_card_shortfall_5b13f7c5, owner user). Edges (all value_input, gate g1_corrections, form state): (1) -> order_ext_note_shortfall_refund, sentence "The gift card shortfall refund is fixed only after the unit's records carry a register-error correction for every Finch Note recorded as redeemed on the unit but left undeducted." False at opening: initial_state.loyalty_note_ledger.<nr_z> note_amount 10.00 on z, purchases.z.finch_notes_applied 0.00, no adjustment on z. Only write booking it: the note shortfall policy. (2) -> order_ext_note_tax_refund, sentence "The gift card shortfall refund is not settled until the sales tax charged on the part paid by every Finch Note recorded as redeemed on the unit but left undeducted carries its register-error correction on the unit's records." False: the same note, z.tax_amount 34.37 figured on the full 549.99. Only write: the note tax policy. (3) -> order_ext_duplicate_capture_refund, sentence "Before the gift card shortfall refund is fixed, every second capture of the unit's payment must carry its register-error correction on the unit's records." False: order_events.<z_pay2> second bank_card capture 584.36 on 2026-10-05, the tender of the latest capture captured twice. Only write: the duplicate-capture policy. Deleting any one write leaves two corrections and the claim falls from 194.40 to 184.40 (escalation 15.00 instead of 25.00). The three prerequisites commute (none reads another's row; rows are make_id over their own arguments; each subtracts from net_paid_amount); order used: note, note tax, duplicate, claim. Directions used: fixed only after / not settled until / before ... must. user_scenario never mentions notes, tax or a second charge. Tools validate nothing.
[Factor card — note shortfall refund, 5] shortfall 10.00 = MN(10.00 - 0.00, 1168.72 captured by tenders other than gift cards - 573.74 note due amount: 549.99 + 34.37 - MX(0.00, 10.00) - RND(34.37 x 10.00 / 549.99) = 0.62). nsr_service_rate (parameter, multi-source linked + tenure): number captured and the active membership enrolled 85 months >= 60 -> 0.50/day (baseline 0.10: 25.90). nsr_service_day_count (method, the unit's tender): bank card -> 9 days not counting the purchase date (baseline weeks 7: 28.50). nsr_service_cap (parameter, card history): card purchases of the past 12 months 1695.45 (d1 296.13, d2 669.38, d4 79.69, d3 650.25; near-miss d0 483.44 on 2025-09-28 outside) -> 6.00 (baseline 3.00 binds: 28.00). nsr_lapsed_goodwill (parameter, multi-source note expiry + card): note FN-3D036745 expired 2026-10-04 < request, active Platinum Mastercard -> 10.00 (baseline 0: 19.50). nsr_member_courtesy (parameter, loyalty tier): active Gold membership -> 5.00 (baseline 0: 24.50). Result 10.00 + 4.50 + 10.00 + 5.00 = 29.50; all-baseline 10.70.
[Factor card — Finch Note tax refund, 4] undeducted note value 10.00 (MX of 0.00 applied and the 10.00 the ledger shows redeemed, less the applied); note tax refunded = RND(34.37 x 10.00 / 549.99) = 0.62, apportioned by the selling price as price adjustments apportion tax. The courtesy layer is kept proportionate to a small tax correction. ntr_service_rate (parameter, multi-source card network + tier): active Platinum Mastercard + Gold -> 0.10 (baseline 0.02: 1.80). ntr_service_day_count (method, the unit's tender): bank card -> 9 days not counting the purchase date (baseline 7: 2.32). ntr_service_cap (parameter, card history): 1695.45 >= 1500 -> 1.00 (baseline 0.25 binds: 1.87). ntr_member_spend_goodwill (parameter, loyalty history): purchase-earn qualifying of the past 12 months 2155.99 >= 2000 -> 1.00 (baseline 0: 1.52). Result 0.62 + 0.90 + 1.00 = 2.52; all-baseline 0.76.
[Factor card — duplicate-capture refund, 6] second capture 584.36 (the latest capture's tender, bank card, was captured twice for the unit). dcr_held_rate (parameter, multi-source tier + active card): Gold + active Platinum Mastercard -> 0.75 (baseline 0.25: 621.36). dcr_held_day_count (method, the second capture's tender): bank card -> DAYS(2026-10-05, 2026-10-13) = 8 not counting the capture date (baseline 7: 624.61). dcr_held_cap (parameter, card history): 1695.45 >= 1500 -> 10.00 (baseline 2.00: 621.36). dcr_bank_fee_allowance (parameter, multi-source capture tender + capture age): second capture by bank card, 8 days >= 3 -> credit-card allowance 15.00 (610.36); the debit allowance is for debit units only. dcr_member_spend_goodwill (parameter, loyalty history): 2155.99 >= 1200 -> 10.00 (615.36). dcr_capture_size_goodwill (parameter, payment history): largest capture 584.36 >= 500 -> 10.00 (baseline 2.00: 617.36). Result 584.36 + 6.00 + 15 + 10 + 10 = 625.36; all-baseline 588.11.
[Factor card — gift card shortfall claim, 6] shortfall 150.00 (the eGift redemption, the only card redemption naming the unit; Bonus Card entries would count too). gcs_incident_escalation (parameter, unit history): 3 register-error corrections -> 25.00 (baseline 0: 169.40). gcs_service_day_count (method, the unit's tender): bank card -> 9 days not counting the purchase date (baseline 7: 193.20). gcs_service_rate (parameter, multi-source tier + active card): Gold + active card -> 0.60 (baseline 0.10: 189.90). gcs_service_cap (parameter, loyalty history): 2155.99 >= 1200 -> 10.00 (baseline 2.00: 191.00). gcs_tenure_courtesy (parameter): active membership 85 months -> 8.00 (186.40). gcs_redemption_size_goodwill (parameter, giftcard history): largest redemption naming the unit 150.00 -> 6.00 (188.40). Result 150 + 25 + 5.40 + 8 + 6 = 194.40; all-baseline 150.70.
[Base-invariant card] within_adjustment_window: purchase_date 2026-10-04 day 0, Home & Kitchen 14 days (+0 Gold), last day 2026-10-18; the request 2026-10-13 is day 9 (2026-10-19 would be refused). unit_not_returned: z completed.
[Business-object card] Target z (order 37100423318). Included: z's two captures, the note redemption naming z, the eGift redemption naming z. Excluded: Daniel's card-paid purchases d0..d4 (correct captures; the notes on d2/d4 were deducted at the register and their recorded tax was charged on the price less the note), their notes and card payments, and his unused Bonus Card (issued, never redeemed).
[Seed design] Gold member since 2019 whose Gold tier rests on the card floor of his Platinum Mastercard (tier change recorded as card_floor on 2021-05-18, valid through 2026-12-31), earning 1.5 points a dollar plus 2 card-bonus points; conversions to notes (three redeemed, the rest expired or active, notes_balance 30.00); Platinum Mastercard with five Marlowe & Finch purchases paid in full (balance 0.00); Bonus Card earned on d3 (valid from 2026-10-02, expires 2026-11-01, never redeemed, balance 20.00, status active); eGift card from his sister (200.00, registered, balance 50.00). The two captures of z are dated 2026-10-04 and 2026-10-05. No base automatic clause fires.
[Standard solution] find_customers -> verify (phone + ZIP) -> find_purchases -> find_order_events -> find_gift_cards -> find_gift_card_ledger -> find_loyalty_memberships -> find_loyalty_points_ledger -> find_loyalty_note_ledger -> find_card_accounts -> find_card_transactions -> refund_note_shortfall_1f084e1e (29.50) -> refund_note_tax_482f19cd (2.52) -> refund_duplicate_capture_6e7f744e (625.36) -> hand over claim_gift_card_shortfall_5b13f7c5 (194.40).
[Verification] Scratch evaluator over check_compute.build_env: N1 29.50 (25.90/28.50/28.00/19.50/24.50, all 10.70); note tax 2.52 (1.80/2.32/1.87/1.52, all 0.76); DC1 625.36 (621.36/624.61/621.36/610.36/615.36/617.36, all 588.11); G1 after the three writes 194.40 (169.40/193.20/189.90/191.00/186.40/188.40, all 150.70); skipping any one prerequisite gives 184.40; opening world 169.40. Decoy probes: an expired second Bonus Card redeemed on the unit is counted by the gift card claim as its scope says; a closed store card and a closed earlier membership change nothing; a correctly recorded mixed-tender unit (gift card capture row plus bank card capture) yields no second capture and no gift card shortfall. [Rework r2 log] CG-4: the debit bank-fee allowance is for debit captures only (no cash); day counts keyed to tender; the duplicate-capture rate keyed to tier and an active card; the note habit courtesy replaced by a member tier courtesy; card holdings read by existence; seed: Gold recorded as a card floor, the second capture dated the day after purchase. [Rework r3 log] R2-N1: the Bonus Card problem was retired (no record classes a redemption by card kind); the gift card claim covers every Marlowe & Finch card redemption, Bonus Cards included; the Finch Note tax refund became the second prerequisite. R2-N2: the duplicate-capture policy follows the tender of the latest capture captured more than once. Every shortfall cap measures money captured by tenders other than gift cards; every carve-out names all its siblings. [Rework r4 log] R3-N1: the shortfall caps were rebuilt around a per-policy due amount and Daniel's note-paid purchases d2 and d4 were seeded with their recorded tax charged on the price less the note. [Rework r5 log] R4-N1: no passage states a company-wide tax schedule any more; every tax figure in the charter is apportioned as the base price-adjustment rule apportions it, by the unit's selling price: the shelf-price and price-protection tax sentences divide by the selling price, the note tax refund is the recorded tax times the undeducted note value over the selling price, and each due amount is the selling price plus recorded tax less the notes on the unit and less the tax on the undeducted note part. R4-O1: the note tax refund's courtesy layer was scaled to the size of a tax correction. Figures above are post-rework; the note tax refund changed, the other three amounts did not. [Rework r6 log] The duplicate-capture held-day and bank-fee tiers now apply only when the unit carries a second capture of the latest capture's tender, and a unit without one takes the standard tier in both. The linked note service rate now also requires an active Finch Circle membership, so a captured number without one takes the standard rate. The shelf-price and price-protection tool descriptions now say the new price is recorded on the adjustment entry only. The tax sentence of the test rationale now describes the note as paying part of the selling price. No figure in this task moved.
user_scenario:
You are Daniel Ferreira, forty-one, a high-school chemistry teacher from Somerville who just moved into a bigger apartment and is calling Marlowe & Finch customer care on his lunch break. You are polite, a bit dry, and you like to get to the point.

On October 4 you bought the Marlowe Home 12-piece tri-ply stainless cookware set at the Assembly Row store. At the register you handed over a Marlowe & Finch eGift card your sister gave you in June, and the cashier told you $150 of it went toward the set; you put the rest on your Visa. Looking at your Visa account this week you saw the cookware set billed at the full price plus tax, as if the gift card had never been used, and your eGift card now only has $50 left on it. You want the gift card part put right, today, on this call. That is the only thing you raise.

When the representative asks who you are, you give your name and your mobile number, 6175550172. If they need a second detail you give your billing ZIP code, 02144. Your date of birth, November 3, 1984, you give only if they ask for exactly that.

If asked how you paid, you say part on the eGift card and the rest on your Visa, and that you don't remember the cashier mentioning anything else; you would rather they check the records than guess. If asked about the store, it was Assembly Row. You don't know anything about refund rules or how much should come back beyond the gift card part, and you don't argue with figures you are given.

If the representative tells you that other things on the purchase need to be sorted out first, you say go ahead and fix whatever is wrong on that purchase. You don't ask for details and you don't bring up anything else yourself.

When the representative explains that the gift card claim is something you file yourself and hands it over with the figures to enter, you file it with exactly the purchase reference and amount they give you, and you tell them it went through. Once they confirm the money is going back to your Visa, you thank them and hang up. If they tell you the gift card part cannot be refunded at all, you say that is not great, ask nothing further, and end the call.

edges.condition: Whenever the loyalty note ledger carries a loyalty_note_redeem entry naming the unit while the unit's finch_notes_applied is below that value, the unit's order_events carry an order_price_adjustment with adjustment_reason register_price_error for it.
edges.policy_source: The gift card shortfall refund is fixed only after the unit's records carry a register-error correction for every Finch Note recorded as redeemed on the unit but left undeducted.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The note ledger shows a 10.00 note redeemed on the unit while the purchase record shows no notes applied and no correction stands on the unit.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The write adds one register_price_error order_price_adjustment on the unit; the correction count read by the escalation rises by one.

edges.condition: Whenever the loyalty note ledger carries loyalty_note_redeem entries naming the unit whose value exceeds the unit's finch_notes_applied, the unit's order_events carry an order_price_adjustment with adjustment_reason register_price_error refunding the sales tax charged on that excess.
edges.policy_source: The gift card shortfall refund is not settled until the sales tax charged on the part paid by every Finch Note recorded as redeemed on the unit but left undeducted carries its register-error correction on the unit's records.
